cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

mechanism: A uses its pupil familiar calming routine to make physical searching surrender entirely to treating invisible keys as emotionally withdrawn.
confusable: Not merely adding an apology to a search: A refuses the final underneath check and demands patient trust instead.
comparison: Negotiating work light versus waiting for lost objects to recover confidence.
